serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Are we going somewhere?
You: You can stop pretending that you didn’t hear what we were talking about, I can see it in your smug face.
Bot: Well, in my defense, she was inviting the both of us anyway.
You: Right…
You: Melissa will be there too. We need to think of something, otherwise, there might be a problem.
Bot: I’m sure she already has an excuse to not eat anything. She wouldn’t accept the invitation if that wasn’t the case.
You: You are probably right.
At times I forget that Melissa has been successfully pretending to be a human for much longer than {f_botName} so she for sure has something up her sleeve.
It might become a problem later down the road, even Annalie will get suspicious at some point, but there’s no point worrying ahead of time.
